title: Caramelized Onions, Mushroom and Cheddar Cheese Frittata
caption:
caramelized onions, mushroom and cheddar cheese frittata
F: 29 | C:47 | P:27
Ingredients:
4 eggs
1 tsp ghee
1 onion, finely sliced 
1 sachet monkfruit sugar 
1 packet button mushroom, quartered
2 green chilli, thinly sliced
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
2 slices cheddar cheese , i use @dlecta
4 slices bread
